title: File:Midway seaplane hangar collapse (51840796131).jpg
desc:
After a series of storms, a torrential downpour caused the World War II-era seaplane hangar on Midway Atoll to collapse, Jan. 13, 2022. USFWS photo: Pam Repp
Almost two months of stormy weather at Midway Atoll has had a dramatic impact on both seabirds and historic World War II infrastructure.

title: File:Silver Maple Samaras.jpg
desc: These samaras are actually considered fruit. The shape of a samara enables the wind to carry the seed farther away than regular seeds from the parent tree. Samaras have several nicknames including helicopters, whirligig, polynose, and spinning jenny. Photo by Joanna Gilkeson/USFWS
